text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That's real selling time returned.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete and consistent, so managers finally had reliable pipeline context.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking consent upfront, and explaining how the data is used, turned most concerns into non-issues.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Reps still had to add judgment.

**5. Coaching improved.** Managers used call snippets to coach on specifics instead of memory.

Our takeaway: AI handles the record. People handle the relationship.

Would your team try it?

*(Scenario is synthetic; figures are illustrative.)*
